svg.title: Process engineer — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as process engineer, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: An opposing-triangle process valve lies in a horizontal pipe beneath a separate gauge branch. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
